subject.title: fix(ci): persist warm runtime caches across runs

question: After an after-fix workflow trace proves a writer-to-later-reader cache handoff, should the repository adopt this single-writer sticky-disk and scheduled/runtime-cache topology?
rationale: The intended benefit depends on provider-specific cache visibility and operational cost tradeoffs that guard tests cannot settle, and the PR carries the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Require live handoff proof, then approve
options.body: Run the proposed warmer/cache writer and attach redacted later-run restore evidence before confirming the topology.

options.title: Keep the existing cache topology
options.body: Decline this ownership change if maintainers do not want the provider-specific lifecycle and verification burden.

recommendation.title: Require live handoff proof, then approve
recommendation.body: Run the proposed warmer/cache writer and attach redacted later-run restore evidence before confirming the topology.
